questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that a school zone is coming up. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop, yield to all traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance areas. Fines for traffic violations double in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow sign alerts drivers to a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot make U-turns at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that wet pavement ahead is slippery and dangerous. Slow down because your vehicle will need more distance to stop on wet roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to road hazards. This sign warns that a sharp turn is coming. You should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted near schools to tell drivers to slow down and watch carefully for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they can turn left at a green light, but they must yield to oncoming traffic first. Complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position because traffic from the opposite direction may be coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass is coming with limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic from another road or lane is about to merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You will see it on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, and horse-drawn wagons. During the day it looks like a solid orange triangle. At night it looks like a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Triangle signs pointing downward mean you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at the marked stop line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: Stop signs are the only eight-sided signs on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the way is clear and you can safely pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that pedestrians may be crossing ahead. If a pedestrian is in the crosswalk, you must stop and wait until they leave the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you which direction traffic must flow on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided roadway is ending and you are entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you must not drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or steering changes, and increase your distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long downgrade ahead. The hill may also have sharp curves.
